body:
Independent QA: **ready for human review under the [explicit native-device deferral](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/issues/405#issuecomment-6041659686)**, superseding [the prior verdict](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/pull/439#issuecomment-6032159061).

Final descriptions, full feedback, the unchanged 63-file scope, CI, configured review and both genuine browser pairs/provenance are verified. Existing source/test/pixel evidence was reused without new suites or captures.

Native service choice, cancel/failure retention, confirmed credential/consent clearing and offline-change switch prevention remain **unexecuted on a device**, deferred for review readiness only. GitHub page rendering remains separately waived. No merge/release approval or readiness controls were exercised; PR402 stays open.

[Immutable assessment and bindings](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/77526a8d64ce7c098732c5f0845db385d9ddd50d/pr439-qa/native-deferral-20261007/verdict.json) · [API receipt record](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/evidence/pr439-qa-20261007-01a114c0/pr439-qa/native-deferral-20261007/receipt.json). Previous verdicts, receipts and the explicit encoding correction are preserved.
